metadata.description: Join the "Sock Monster Scavenger Hunt" and help Socksie find socks hidden around your house! Listen to clues, search common spots, and move to the next chapter upon success. Perfect for kids and families seeking a playful adventure. Setup is easy with our guide—just hide the socks and start the fun!
